observation: Fresh main allowed a federated candidate with more than 128 normalized changes to remain executable and eligible for consensus/ranking even though ChangesetStore.stage has an existing MAX_FILES=128 hard gate and will deterministically reject the same plan with TOO_MANY_CHANGES.
changes: Reuse the existing ChangeSet hard budget of 128 as the federated executable change-count boundary.
Fail oversized candidates closed before normalization/ranking, expose change_overflow and observed_change_count, and record CHANGESET_FILE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED evidence.
Preserve exactly-128-change plans and all existing change-shape, ambiguity, overlap, validation-command, consensus, and ranking behavior.
